# sidecar.get_psf { #healpyxel.sidecar.get_psf }

```python
sidecar.get_psf(psf_type, sigma=None)
```

Return a PSF callable for the given type.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type          | Description                                                                    | Default    |
|----------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| psf_type | str           | PSF model name. Supported values: ``'gaussian'``, ``'none'``.                  | _required_ |
| sigma    | float or None | Standard deviation for the Gaussian PSF (required if ``psf_type='gaussian'``). | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                                    |
|--------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | callable | A PSF function that accepts ``(dx, dy)`` and returns a weight. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                        |
|--------|------------|------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If ``psf_type`` is not recognized. |
